item.title: Intelligent Transport and Sustainable Mobility in Urban Systems: Models, Data, Management and Policy Insights
item.content:encoded:
This special issue in Research in Transportation Business & Management seeks contributions on intelligent transportation systems and sustainable mobility solutions within urban environments. The focus spans the development of analytical models, utilization of data analytics, operational management strategies, and policy frameworks that support the transition toward more efficient and environmentally conscious urban mobility systems.

item.title: Port Governance - Reloaded: From Devolution to Transformation in a Polycrisis Era
item.content:encoded:
This special issue examines evolving governance structures and transformations in port management within the context of contemporary global challenges. It addresses how port governance systems are adapting and being reorganized in response to multiple interconnected crises and shifting operational requirements.

item.title: Socially Responsible Urban Freight Transport
item.content:encoded:
This special issue of Research in Transportation Business & Management focuses on socially responsible approaches to urban freight transport. The issue seeks to explore how freight operations in urban environments can balance economic efficiency with social and environmental considerations.
